description: This Java class 'BaseAlarmCommentService' provides service methods for creating, updating, saving, and retrieving alarm comments within the Thingsboard platform. It manages alarm comment entities, validates data, and publishes events related to alarm comment lifecycle.

classes.name: BaseAlarmCommentService
classes.description: Service class for managing alarm comments, including creation, update, retrieval, and event publishing.

methods.name: createOrUpdateAlarmComment
methods.description: Creates a new alarm comment or updates an existing one, validates data, and publishes save events.

methods.name: saveAlarmComment
methods.description: Saves an alarm comment to the database, validates data, and publishes delete events.

methods.name: findAlarmComments
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of alarm comments for a specific alarm.

methods.name: findAlarmCommentByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an alarm comment by its ID.

methods.name: findAlarmCommentById
methods.description: Finds an alarm comment by its ID.

methods.name: createAlarmComment
methods.description: Initializes and saves a new alarm comment, setting default type if necessary.

methods.name: updateAlarmComment
methods.description: Updates an existing alarm comment, marking it as edited.
